scope: CLI managed recheck publication and control boundary; isolated actual IFC fixtures

contract.owner: Fresh explicit recheck run bound to the existing candidate
contract.report_authority: Existing managed child receipt and parent admission protocol
contract.exit_0: Completed check with published bound report, including physical FAIL
contract.exit_2: Incomplete execution or admission error; no report claimed by this invocation

actual_native_cases: Historical managed PASS: fresh supervised check publishes a new bound report.
Historical managed FAIL: fresh supervised check publishes FAIL and exits 0 for completed execution.
Actual private native PASS followed by a sleeping child: timeout exits 2, candidate UNKNOWN, report unpublished, acceptance rejected.
additional_cases: Setup error does not present a retained earlier report as the current invocation's result.
Nonfinite, zero, negative, excessive and boolean budgets are rejected before storage is created.
